crossItemFindings: All 40 have a uniquely best answer under their stated conditions.
1005/1027 both use sanitization before asset release/reuse, with different lifecycle decisions.
1012/1034 both address SIEM ingestion gaps; 1034 adds collaborative retest.
1025/1026 are an intentional conceptual/application pair on exercise capability.
Many stems explicitly prescribe policy or goal, yielding easy reading-comprehension decisions and weak distractors.
No English grammar mismatch was needed to select a key; multiple correct options echo stem wording or are the only relevant action.
